name: recipe
title: Recipe Installer
description: Install game-data recipes from ZIP, DOS floppy, ISO and CUE/BIN files.
about: Standalone recipe installer used by Launcher UI. Validates recipe downloads and extracts supported archives and disc images to SD or USB. Open an app detail page in Launcher UI to select its recipe and source media.
controls: Launcher UI app details: select Install data
Touch or mouse: choose source files and start extraction
Hold Menu 3 s: return to the launcher
changelog: 0.1.1: extract Another World DOS files from FAT floppy images and ZIP archives.
